live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#745; borg-reborn-rs #1140, PR #1146 at 1909efb9, the owner's re-review fixes; replaces 7d9c8078 and 5e92db2d). Two arms: ctl (deal_with_poison 0, shipped) and deal (deal_with_poison 1: a poison triage built on the HP the poison still takes, with the six parts A note, F cure carried, B late drink, C leave, D town, E fight race; poison_late_drink_margin 2 and poison_cure_pending_percent 50 kept at their defaults). Each world's arms are compared only inside that world (RULES 21): poison-x8 (harness/worlds/poison-x8.txt, #741's world) and the normal world. Runs: pilot first in both worlds (classes-18, evidence retained); poison-x8 needs more starts than #741's verysmall (1 ctl death in 45): starts 1-360 (verysmall, small-rest, medium) here, 1-300 as the request asks at least; the normal world starts 1-900 to measure the cost elsewhere.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, world poison-x8, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen 1909efb9 with the poison-x8 world pinned. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell of a world records it with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report: deaths per arm, poison deaths apart (jelly, worm mass, other), rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), DL3 and DL5 reached; from the notes (pilot evidence, all tagged #1140) per arm: '# Poison: cured with what it carries', '# Poison: late drink', '# Leaving (the poison outlasts HP and healing, #1140)', '# Recalling: the poison takes', '# Poison triage: ... buying', '# Poison fight race: ... lost', '# Stepping out of reach of a poisoner that never moves'; the death report (/death-report) for every deal death that ctl survived. Local direction (borg-cemetery#146 replays, not a claim): Rogue 626789725, Druid 799968561 and Ranger 956247604 die with ctl and live with deal; Paladin 1200156945 dies in both. Descriptive (RULES 14).
